description: Source code for the ClearKey Content Access System (CAS) plugin implementation, including factory classes, session management, decryption routines, and plugin interfaces for Android media DRM.

classes.name: ClearKeyCasFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and querying ClearKey CAS plugins supported system ID.

classes.name: ClearKeyDescramblerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating ClearKey descrambler plugins supported system ID.

classes.name: ClearKeyCasPlugin
classes.description: Implementation of the CAS plugin interface, managing sessions, provisioning, and ECM processing.

classes.name: ClearKeyDescramblerPlugin
classes.description: Implementation of the descrambler interface for ClearKey, handling decryption and session association.

classes.name: ClearKeyCasSession
classes.description: Represents a session within the ClearKey CAS plugin, managing ECM updates and decryption.

methods.name: updateECM
methods.description: Updates ECM data, obtains decryption keys, and sets up decryption parameters.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts sub-samples using AES keys, handling scrambling control.

methods.name: decryptPayload
methods.description: Performs AES-128 CBC-CTS decryption on TS payloads.

methods.name: setMediaCasSession
methods.description: Associates a media CAS session with the descrambler.

methods.name: provision
methods.description: Initializes license provisioning with a provided string.
